text: Stop the agent runtime from changing its own version under Athena: turn off its auto-updater in the environment Athena sets up (setup.sh), or install it where the updater cannot change it. Then add an operator command that needs no agent job. It should find an installed version that differs from the pin, run a smoke test, update the pin in athena.toml, and log the change as an event. Add tests that put in a mismatched version and show the command repins and a job can start afterwards. Keep the current pin.
